resources.string: Hide screenshot, VPN, proxy, developer and debugging state per app. All methods default to enabled; Vector manages scope.
All protections are enabled by default
Enable this module in Vector and select the apps to protect. After changing its scope, force stop and reopen the selected apps.

Blocks official screenshot callbacks, media queries and change notifications, file access and directory monitoring, plus identifiable screenshot broadcasts, clipboard data, notifications and accessibility metadata.
Selected apps will no longer see existing or new screenshots. This may affect selecting or uploading screenshots in those apps. Other images remain visible.
The module runs inside app processes where Vector loads it. The system continues to save screenshots normally.
